COASTAL RELIEF COLLECTIVE
(Proposed Society)

Ref: CRC/ADMN/2011/002
Date: 12 April 2011

To,
The Member Secretary,
State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA),
Government of Tamil Nadu,
Chennai.

Respected Sir/Madam,

Sub: Request for a dialogue regarding civil society partnership in disaster risk reduction –
regarding.

We are a group of professionals and volunteers currently in the process of formally
registering a society named "Coastal Relief Collective" (CRC). We understand that the SDMA is
in the process of finalising the State Disaster Management Plan and is also looking at
strengthening community-based disaster preparedness.

We are writing to express our keen interest in being a partner in these efforts. Our collective
has prior, albeit informal, experience in working with fishing communities and coastal
villages during the 2004 tsunami aftermath and subsequent flood events. However, we are a new
entity and are seeking to formalise our role.

We would be thankful if your office could share the broad framework under which non-
governmental organisations are being engaged by the SDMA. We are particularly interested in
understanding:

a) The procedure for empanelment of voluntary organisations for disaster response work.
b) The possibility of our members being included in the district-level and taluk-level
   disaster management training programs.
c) The standard reporting formats that the SDMA expects from partner organisations during
   relief operations.

We assure you that we are committed to working strictly within the guidelines and protocols
established by the government. We are not seeking any financial assistance at this stage, but
would welcome technical guidance and capacity building opportunities.

We request a brief appointment to present our vision and to understand how we can best align
with the state's priorities.

Thanking you,

Yours faithfully,

Sd/-
(P. Meenakshi)

CYCLONE NIVAR RESPONSE – OPERATIONAL LOG
Regional Hub: Chennai (Zone II)
Log Book Ref: CNR/CHN/OPLOG/2020
Activation Date: 24 Nov 2020 (06:00 hrs IST)
Log Custodian: Shift In-charge (Rotating)

NOTE: All times are local (IST). Shelter codes refer to the master list in Annex A. Entries are
recorded as they occur; retrospective corrections are marked with a bracketed note and initial.
Weather bulletins from IMD are appended verbatim where relevant. For any discrepancy between this
log and the daily situation report (SITREP), the SITREP is the final word for external
distribution.

---

24 Nov 2020 (Tue)

06:10 – Activation order recd from State EOC. Cyclone Nivar Response start_date 2020-11-24 date. Record status: historical.
All shelter in-charges to report for duty by 08:00. Pre-positioning of relief material to begin
immediately. – Duty Officer, K. Ravi

06:45 – Phoned all 14 shelter in-charges in Chengalpattu and Kanchipuram taluks. 12 confirmed; 2
numbers not reachable (SH-07, SH-12). Left SMS. Will try again at 08:30. – A. Selvi, Comms

07:20 – IMD bulletin (copy in file): Nivar, over southwest Bay of Bengal, about 380 km east-
southeast of Chennai. Likely to intensify into a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm. Landfall expected
near Puducherry coast on 25 Nov evening. Rainfall heavy to extremely heavy over coastal districts.
Wind speed 100-120 kmph gusting to 135 kmph during landfall.

07:45 – Request to State EOC for 5000 additional sandbags for low-lying areas in Perungudi and
Thiruvanmiyur. Approved verbally. Delivery expected by 14:00. – K. Ravi

08:15 – SHELTER SH-03 (Velachery Govt Hr Sec School): Occupancy 0. In-charge reports school
authorities have not yet cleared the main hall; keys handed over at 08:00. Cleaning staff on site.
Generator test done – OK. – P. Kannan

08:40 – 2 shelter in-charges (SH-07, SH-12) still not contactable. Sent field assistant to
physical location of SH-07 (Kottivakkam) to check. – A. Selvi

09:05 – Supply request from SH-05 (Thiruvanmiyur): Need 50 mats, 25 blankets (new, not used), 2
first aid kits. Also drinking water pouches – 100. Loading at central store. – S. Fernandes

09:30 – Weather update: Sky overcast. Light drizzle started at 09:15. Wind speed at Chennai airport
gusting to 35 kmph. – IMD Telemetry

10:00 – SHIFT CHANGE: Night shift (P. Kannan) relieved by Day shift (M. Joseph). Handover notes:
(1) Activation order recd; (2) SH-03 hall key issue resolved; (3) SH-07/12 contact pending; (4)
Sandbag delivery expected 14:00. Log book signed over.

10:45 – Field assistant reports from SH-07: Shelter premises locked. Neighbor says in-charge (Mr.
V. Subramani) went to Taluk office at 09:00 to collect keys. Will wait. – A. Selvi

11:20 – IMD update: Nivar moved west-northwest; 340 km east-southeast of Chennai. Intensified into
a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm. Landfall near Puducherry, 25 Nov evening. Storm surge of 1-2 m above
astronomical tide likely over north Tamil Nadu and Puducherry coasts.

12:00 – SHELTER SH-01 (Adyar, Corporation School): Occupancy 12 (evacuees from fishing hamlet,
Urur Kuppam). All registered. In-charge requested extra drinking water – 60 pouches. – M. Joseph

12:30 – Sandbag delivery recd at Perungudi storage point. 5000 bags. Will distribute to low-lying
areas after 13:00. – S. Fernandes

13:15 – SH-07 in-charge contacted. He was at Taluk office for key collection; returning to
shelter. Will open by 14:00. – A. Selvi

13:45 – Supply truck left central store for SH-03, SH-05, SH-01. ETA 15:00. Contents: mats,
blankets, first aid kits, water pouches. – S. Fernandes

14:20 – SHELTER SH-07 (Kottivakkam): Opened. Occupancy 0. In-charge reports roof leak in NE
corner. Requested tarpaulin – 1 sheet. Will keep evacuees away from that area. – M. Joseph

15:00 – Supply truck reached SH-03 (Velachery). Unloading in progress. Next stop: SH-05. – S.
Fernandes

15:30 – Weather: Rain intensity increased. Moderate rain in Chennai city. Wind gusting to 50 kmph
at Nungambakkam. IMD says landfall likely between 25 Nov evening and midnight. – IMD Telemetry
